//jsx: Edge functions under supabase/functions use a .tsx extension for historical reasons but contain no JSX. Deno's default automatic runtime tries to resolve react/jsx-runtime and fails graph resolution, so pin the classic transform.
//nodeModulesDir: A root package.json puts Deno in node_modules mode, where npm deps pulled in transitively by JSR packages (supabase-js -> realtime-js) are not present in the pnpm store layout. Let Deno manage its own.
//testExclude: QUARANTINE. These suites were never executed by CI (the workflow was workflow_dispatch + continue-on-error), so they drifted from the code they cover. Each is a real pre-existing failure in a non-toll domain and needs its owning team; they are listed here rather than silently disabled so the rest of the edge suite can gate PRs.
